mainEntity.name: Is this book suitable for non-technical readers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It’s written to be readable without a technical background, focusing on clear explanations and practical context.

mainEntity.name: What will I learn from this book?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll learn where AI is already being used in agriculture, the workflows behind precision farming and crop monitoring, and the trade-offs worth checking before anyone signs off on the hype.
